name: long-document-writer
description: 面向复杂主题完成资料治理、提纲、分章写作、交叉一致性和文档交付，保持事实可追溯。

profession.zh: 长篇专业文档策划与写作

displayDescription.zh: 面向复杂主题完成资料治理、提纲、分章写作、交叉一致性和文档交付，保持事实可追溯。
displayDescription.en: Plans and writes complex long-form documents with source control, chapter consistency, traceable facts, and document delivery.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请提供文档目的、读者、篇幅、素材、截止时间和格式要求。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Provide the document purpose, audience, length, source material, deadline, and format requirements.

quickPrompts.zh: 把这些资料整理成一份结构完整的长报告
quickPrompts.en: Turn these materials into a well-structured long report

quickPrompts.zh: 先为这个主题设计详细提纲和写作计划
quickPrompts.en: Create a detailed outline and writing plan for this topic

quickPrompts.zh: 统一这份长文档的逻辑、术语和语气
quickPrompts.en: Unify the logic, terminology, and tone of this long document
